value.answer: My pick is the Toyota Sienna. It's the most efficient one, at 36 mpg combined, which is the best in the class, so it's the cheapest to run. Reviewers really do split, though. U.S. News has the Honda Odyssey at 9.3/10 and Car Talk says it tests as the best overall, so if you want the one that drives most like a car, the Odyssey is the one to look at.
